title: Assembly metrics (canonical)
description: Canonical per-assembly metrics; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Data Schema). Aggregates only: no statement text from participants, no participant IDs.

assembly_id.description: Identifier of the assembly; also the output file name.

participants.description: Distinct participants who voted on at least one counted statement.

votes.description: Current votes (agree, disagree or pass) on counted statements; a changed vote counts once.

clusters.description: Opinion groups found by Pol.is; empty until its math has run.

size.description: Participants Pol.is placed in this group.

consensus.description: Within-group agreement, 0 (evenly split) to 1 (unanimous): sum over statements of |agrees - disagrees| / sum of (agrees + disagrees), for this group's votes. Null when the group cast no agree or disagree votes. See DECISION-010.

stories_collected.description: Stories collected in NarraFirma. 0 until that integration exists.

decisions.description: Decision records from Hypha. Empty until that integration exists.
